analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 78.8 continues in overbought territory, maintaining uptrend with 5-day high continuation. MACD histogram improving, indicating expanding bullish momentum. However, volume ratio at 0.81 suggests weakening upward momentum as price approaches the upper Bollinger Band. Maintaining a wait-and-see stance for the third consecutive session.

[거래량·결론]

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($1.47) vs SMA5/20/50 ($1.44/$1.20/$1.14) — trading above short-term and mid-term trends.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($1.15/$1.28) — strong mid-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (21.9%) + current price range historically low.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (62.5→78.8) + continuing into overbought + maintaining upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.0061→0.0588) + continued improvement + confirmed trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near upper band $1.50) + 66.07% band width.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($1.38) + basis (pivot/swing low/moving average based).
· Swing resistance ($1.49) + breaking through expected to extend 5-day high.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day high continuation, rising from 20-day low) + maintaining uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.81x) + reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (uptrend) + wait-and-see conditions considering potential weakening of upward momentum.
